rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for showing contempt or disdain.

example.english: They looked at me scornfully and walked away.
example.traditional: 佢不屑咁望住我，轉身就走。
example.jyutping: keoi5 bat1 sit3 gam3 mong6 zyu6 ngo5 zyun3 san1 zau6 zau2

rows.note: Use this when the scorn is expressed through mocking, sarcastic remarks rather than silent disdain.

example.english: They spoke scornfully: “So capable—why can’t you even do the job?”
example.traditional: 佢冷嘲熱諷咁話：「咁叻，點解份工都做唔掂呀？」
example.jyutping: keoi5 laang5 zaau1 jit6 fung3 gam3 waa6 gam3 lek1 dim2 gaai2 fan6 gung1 dou1 zou6 m4 dim6 aa3
